WhoAmI has three ways of working: 

Syntax 1:
111: This utility can be used to get user name and group information
112: along with the respective security identifiers (SID), claims,
113: privileges, logon identifier (logon ID) for the current user
114: on the local system. I.e. who is the current logged on user?
115: If no switch is specified, tool displays the user name in NTLM
120: /UPN                    Displays the user name in User Principal
122: /FQDN                   Displays the user name in Fully Qualified
124: /USER                   Displays information on the current user
127: /GROUPS                 Displays group membership for current user,
131: including claim name, flags, type and values.
132: /PRIV                   Displays security privileges of the current
134: /LOGONID                Displays the logon ID of the current user.
136: /ALL                    Displays the current user name, groups
137: belonged to along with the security
141: /FO       format        Specifies the output format to be displayed.
142: Valid values are TABLE, LIST, CSV.
143: Column headings are not displayed with CSV
145: /NH                     Specifies that the column header should not
146: be displayed in the output. This is
147: valid only for TABLE and CSV formats.
